scope: Ten purposively selected Q3 recommended entities: five from each platform, drawn from the two selected repetitions per platform. No original observations or C/M/R labels changed.
selection_rationale: Cover practical creators, commercial research, agencies, a publisher, community curation and founder-oriented guides. This is not random sampling or a matched test of platform quality.
checks_performed: Open one recorded primary/bylined URL per selected entity
Distinguish original completed observations from interpretation, curation and suggested workflows
Record whether method and sample information is present, with explicit qualifications

limitations: This is post-hoc assistant analysis on 2026-11-02, after the original experiment. Pages may have changed; current content does not prove what was available at collection time.
The purposive cases cannot estimate the share of good recommendations on either platform. No per-platform quality score is calculated.
Readable content establishes availability to this retrieval tool, not that its data, causal claims, authorship credentials or free-plan operation were independently validated.
No course, download, commercial tool or content intervention was executed. No email was submitted.
The audit covers ten source pages, not every resource, paper or link on those pages. Non-observation on one page is not proof the entity never publishes original experiments.
